title: What are Variables?
overview: Variables are containers used to store data values in Python. Unlike many languages, Python does not require declaring the variable type explicitly.

title: Creating Variables
overview: Variables are created automatically when a value is assigned to them. The variable name should be meaningful and follow Python naming rules.

title: String Data Type
overview: Strings are used to store text values. They are written inside single or double quotes.

title: Numeric Data Types
overview: Python supports numeric types including integers, floating point numbers, and complex numbers.

title: Boolean Data Type
overview: Boolean values represent True or False. They are commonly used in conditions and decision-making.

title: Checking Data Types
overview: Python provides the type() function to check the data type of a variable.

title: Type Conversion
overview: Type conversion allows changing a value from one data type to another using built-in Python functions.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how variables work in Python, different data types, checking types, and converting values between types.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Variables store data.
✔ Python uses dynamic typing.
✔ Common types are string, number, and boolean.
✔ type() checks data type.
✔ Type conversion changes values.
